title: AdaBoost
interviewAnswer: AdaBoost sequentially focuses new weak learners on examples previous learners misclassified, then combines learners with performance-based weights. It illustrates boosting before gradient-boosted trees.
keyPoints: Weak learners combine into strong ensemble.
Sensitive to noisy labels/outliers in some settings.
why: AdaBoost is a recurring foundation across data science and machine learning because it affects both theoretical correctness and practical system behavior.
intuition: Weak learners combine into strong ensemble.
deepDive: AdaBoost sequentially focuses new weak learners on examples previous learners misclassified, then combines learners with performance-based weights. It illustrates boosting before gradient-boosted trees. Misclassified points receive more emphasis. Sensitive to noisy labels/outliers in some settings. The interview-level skill is not merely recalling the definition: explain the assumptions, what diagnostic evidence you would inspect, and what alternative you would choose when those assumptions fail.
workedExample: Combine many decision stumps while increasing weight on examples the ensemble keeps missing.
commonMistakes: Using the concept mechanically without checking assumptions or data semantics.
Reporting one metric/result without examining uncertainty, slices or failure modes.
followUps: What assumptions or limitations does AdaBoost have?
How would you validate AdaBoost on a real dataset?
production: In production, make assumptions explicit, validate on representative slices, compare with a simple baseline and monitor the signals that can drift.
